# S3.4b — run ledger

## Spec / Base / Branch / Config
- Spec: `docs/tickets/048_S3.4b__results-store.md`
  (§6.5 — `ResultsRow/1`, `project_row`, row versions, `build_cells`,
  reads, the bundle catalogue, `verify_row`, and the lab-internal
  `leaderboard()` with L1–L5)
- Satisfies: R-2.10.5⁰
- Base: `svitali/harnessharness-s3.4a` @ `6283fee` · Branch:
  `svitali/harnessharness-s3.4b`
- autonomous: checkpoint · live stage: offline-only (hermetic only)
- Owning ADRs (cite, never re-decide): ADR-0161/0162/0163 (results store,
  experiment ledger, leaderboard), ADR-0139/0140 (bundle members,
  R-levels), ADR-0026/0029 (envelope chain), ADR-0041 (M-modes),
  ADR-0029 (the one hasher).
- Decisions taken: **ADR-0279** — `bundle_id`→manifest pool resolution by
  recomputation, `validated` = `check_completeness` (S1/S2/S4/S7), `at`-read
  historical-version selection, `claimed_level` (not `level_now`) as the L1
  reproducibility gate, the engine's E-4 `budget_match`/`under_utilised`
  records consumed (never re-derived) with `unmatched_budget`/`imbalanced`
  dispositions, the Stage-3 L1–L5 gate-ladder mapping to spec L1–L9, and
  the `commit_envelopes` HLC re-chain fix.

## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first. Dispositions:

- **DF-S1.24-1 (F)** — progress note appended (2026-09-22): the
  results-store half lands here — `ResultsRow/1` + `project_row`, row
  versions + heads, `build_cells` + the read surface, the bundle
  catalogue, `verify_row`/`verify_citation`, `leaderboard()` L1–L5. The
  estimator-kernel ops (S3.4c), compatibility consumers (S5.4) and debt
  manager (S6.1b) stay OPEN.
- **DF-S1.24-2 (V)** — progress note appended (2026-09-22): the §6.5
  executables now run — factor-keyed `query_rows` (+ `cell_na:` filters,
  `UnknownField`/`UnknownCursor` refusals, cursor pagination),
  `cells()`/`distribution()`, the L1 bundle/`claimed_level` admission
  arms, per-cell audit citations, and `budget_imbalanced`/
  `under_utilised` entry flags. The real foreign-manifest import
  (GATE-G2 `benchmarkSet`) stays OPEN.
- No rows closed; no rows deleted; no new rows opened.

## Evidence report

- `crates/hh-results/tests/results.rs` — 14 integration tests over a real
  `Store` + `LabDocs` + `ExperimentEngine` rig (2 arms × 1 task × 2
  replicates):
  - `project_row_is_deterministic_and_refuses_typed` — byte-identical
    re-projection; `NotSubjectRun`, `RunNotDurable`,
    `RegistryVersionUnknown` refusals (AC-1/§2.1 error column).
  - `row_codec_round_trips_and_ids_recompute` — `to_json`/`from_json`
    round-trip, `compute_version_id`/`compute_view_hash` recompute.
  - `versions_supersede_and_heads_resolve` — overlay regrade lands a new
    version with `supersedes` + `derived_from_reason = regrade`, `head`
    moves, `row_history` shows both, the old version's bytes are intact,
    `NoChange`/`OverlayNotTargeting` refusals (AC-6).
  - `reads_repeat_at_watermark_and_refuse_ahead` — `at`-pinned queries
    serve the newest covered *version* (not the head), repeat to equal
    `view_hash`, `WatermarkAhead` on pins beyond the durable head and on
    unknown runs (AC-5).
  - `every_cell_cites_a_verifying_audit_ref` — every cell, `n/a` cells
    included, cites ≥1 verifying ref; tampered/beyond-head refs report
    `Tampered`/`Missing` (AC-12).
  - `verify_row_detects_stale_and_corrupt` — re-projection recomputes the
    true id; a forged `version_id` in stored bytes fails the report;
    `UnknownVersion` is typed (AC-1/§2.2 verify row).
  - `redacted_evidence_reports_missing_not_silent` — blob redaction flips
    a cell's citation to `Missing{redacted}`, never drops it (AC-12).
  - `build_cells_reports_every_attempt_with_reasons` — 2×1×2 cells, per-
    metric `{values, n}` folds, unlaunched cells report empty row lists,
    equal `view_hash` on re-fold (AC-3's cell-table half).
  - `catalogue_tracks_bundles_and_leaderboard_gates_l1_to_l5` — the
    AC-R-2.10.5-3 fixture: no bundle / `assembled` (withheld member
    bytes) / `validated` R0 / `validated` R1 (compiled-bundle member +
    `control.decision` replay basis); the default leaderboard admits
    exactly the two validated subjects, `min_claimed_level = R1` admits
    one, every exclusion names its gate + reason; deterministic
    stratum-major ordering, head citations verify, repeatable
    `snapshot_id`.
  - `leaderboard_l5_excludes_uncomparable_rows` — exploratory bindings
    (`comparable = false`) report, never rank.
  - `rebuild_all_reproduces_and_annotate_indexes` — rebuild into a fresh
    store reproduces every `version_id` and row bytes; `annotate` index
    cites head versions (AC-1).
  - `query_rows_filters_factors_paginates_and_distributes` — factor
    filters (`arm_id`, `configuration_version_id`, `task_id`,
    `split_label`, `outcome_class`, `experiment_run_id`,
    `cell_na:<metric>`), `UnknownField`/`UnknownCursor` refusals, cursor
    pagination covering the key set, `distribution()` per-task `(c, n)` +
    quantiles (AC-2).
  - `class_scoped_na_cells_render_and_cite` — a hosted `events`-only run
    renders `n/a{class}` (native-only metrics) and `n/a{observability}`
    (end-state metrics); nothing scores 0 by absence; `n/a` cells still
    cite (AC-7).
  - `leaderboard_flags_imbalance_never_excludes` — divergent realised
    consumption closes the comparand group `imbalanced` and the light arm
    `under_utilised`; both land as entry flags, all four rows still rank
    (AC-9's flag arm).
- `hh-ledger` — `commit_envelopes` now re-chains `prev_hash` after HLC
  stamping (the S3.4b `verify_run` work surfaced stored
  `Tampered{chain_broken}` on lineage-bearing runs); additive accessors
  `run_ids`, `blob_digests`, `blob_status` (pub) — no contract changes.

## Acceptance-criteria verdicts

- **AC-R-2.10.5-1** rebuild equality — MET (`rebuild_all_reproduces_*`:
  fresh-store rebuild reproduces every `version_id` and row byte;
  catalogue/annotation index re-derived).
- **AC-R-2.10.5-2** factor keys — MET at this slice's shape (2 arms × 1
  task × 2 replicates): rows keyed `(configuration_version_id, run_id)`,
  `query_rows` groups by every declared coordinate, `cells()`/`distribution()`
  answer the per-arm compare, no name-keyed field exists (`UnknownField`).
  The full 2-snapshot × 2-variant × 3-task fixture awaits the multi-task
  suite surface (benchmarkSet).
- **AC-R-2.10.5-3** no score without object — MET (no-bundle/`assembled`/
  `validated` R0/`validated` R1 arms; `min_claimed_level = R1` admits one;
  exclusions name gate + reason).
- **AC-R-2.10.5-5** watermark repeatability — MET (`at`-pinned pages are
  `view_hash`-stable; `WatermarkAhead` typed).
- **AC-R-2.10.5-6** row versions — MET (overlay regrade → new version,
  `supersedes`, `head` moves, history ordered, old bytes intact).
- **AC-R-2.10.5-7** class-scoped rendering — MET for the class/observability
  halves (`n/a{class}`/`n/a{observability}` cells, never 0-by-absence,
  per-stratum ranks); the hosted-row *leaderboard* arm is unreachable at
  Stage 3 (no hosted subject launches) — the L2 applicability gate is
  implemented and lands its executable coverage with the hosted tiers.
- **AC-R-2.10.5-9** matched budget — MET at this layer: stratum =
  `MatchSpec` idp (ranks never cross), arms without a usable spec are
  `unmatched_budget` exclusions (unreachable through the engine —
  `validate_match` refuses at declaration — the gate is defensive per
  ADR-0279 D5), and the E-4 close record lands `imbalanced`/
  `under_utilised` as entry flags, never exclusions.
- **AC-R-2.10.5-12** citations verify — MET (every cell cites a verifying
  `audit_ref`; redaction resolves `Missing{redacted}`).

## Deferred / compensating controls

- Hosted-leaderboard arms (cross-class rank refusal over real hosted
  rows) — Stage-4/T-LCD-06 territory; the L2 applicability gate is the
  compensating control.
- `rescore`'s `RevokedValidator` mode, `subscribe`, `export_rows`,
  `snapshots`/`diff_snapshots`, L6–L9, `publish` — Stage-4 item scope per
  the manifest's C1 row.
- `unmatched_budget` exclusions are unreachable end-to-end at Stage 3
  (declaration refuses un-matched arms) — defensive gate, named reason.
